        April 2026 – present · Work project
        
HR & Payroll ERP

        
An ERP for people, leave, payroll and the books, which I build in my current role. Below is an anonymized working copy built with the app's own design tokens. Follow the three steps, explore all 19 finance sections, tick off the to-do list, drag tasks across the board, upload a file, open the command palette with ⌘K, or switch to Arabic and watch the whole layout mirror. All records are sample data.

        July 2026 · Mobile
        
Wally: Know where your money goes

        
A Flutter expense tracker for Oman. Snap a receipt and on-device text recognition reads the merchant and total, then an AI assistant helps you spot where to save.

        
    
          
  • Receipt scanning with ML Kit text recognition
    • 
          
  • Amounts in rials to three decimals, with the official rial symbol
    • 
          
  • Spending by category chart
    • 
          
  • Penny, an AI budgeting assistant
    • 
          
  • Firebase Auth and Firestore sync
    •
